user_query: I want to surprise my friends with a karaoke night. Can you provide me with the lyrics of popular songs by different artists? Also, fetch the comments and discussions related to the songs from the SongMeanings database. Additionally, recommend the top artists of the year to create a playlist for the karaoke night.

TaskList.description: Fetch popular songs and their lyrics from a music lyrics API.
Fetch comments and discussions related to the songs from the SongMeanings database.
Recommend the top artists of the year for creating a playlist.
